title: andrographis serpyllifolia
intro: Andrographis serpyllifolia, commonly known as Himalayan king of bitters, is a plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing fever, relieving digestive issues, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Andrographis serpyllifolia are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory activity, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include andrographolide, neoandrographolide, and andrographiside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
